ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 2day of December, 2010, by and between NEW YORK 61" STREET ESTATE INC. ("Owner"), a Delaware corporation, having an address at c/o Graff Holdings, Inc., 46 East 61st Street, New York, New York 10065, and 43-45 EAST 60TH LLC (*"Developer"), a New York limited liability company, having an address at c/o Zeckendorf Realty, L.P., 770 Lexington Avenue, New York, New York 10021. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is the fee owner of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon,located in the Borough of Manhattan, City,County and State of New York,known as Lot 42 inBlock1375on theTaxMap of theCity of NewYork,County of New York (the “Tax Map") and as and by the street address 46 East 61st Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Owner Land"; the building located thereon is herein referred to as the "Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 129 in Block 1375 on the Tax Map, and as and by the street address 43-45 hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer Land"; the building and improvements thereon are herein referred to as the “Existing Developer Building"); WHEREAS,Developer has previously purchased certain Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the land located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of NewYork, known as Lot 31 in Block 1375 on the Tax Map,and as and by the street address 47 East 60*h Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B-1" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land is herein referred to as the “Lot appurtenant to the Development RightsParcel,identified as Lot9031 inBlock1375on the Tax Map (the “Cantilever Parcel"); and (b) combined the Lot 31 Parcel,including the Cantilever Parcel, and the Developer Land into a single zoning lot (the“Developer Existing Zoning Lot") by Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions dated May 31,2006 and recorded as CRFN 2006000364369 in the Office of the Register of the City of New York, New York County ("Parcel” shall mean the Owner Parcel or the Developer Parcel (as hereinafter defined)); WHEREAS, Developer presently intends to demolish the Existing Developer Building and to construct a new building, all or a portion of which will be on the Developer Land and/or on the Cantilever Parcel and/or on any'Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined) and to 2 KL32594041.8

construct other improvements associated with such new building (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building"; and the Developer Land and the Existing Developer Building or the Developer Building, as the case may be, are herein collectively WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel· pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Parcel and any Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS,it-is contemplated that the Developer Building will contain more floor area than is now available for use on the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for the Merged Zoning Lot (as. hereinafter defined) so as to make available the Excess Development Rights for utilization in connection with the construction and maintenance of the Developer Building, and Owner is willing to make such Excess Development Rights available toDeveloper in perpetuity; WHEREAS, the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing (i) a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in Section 12-10(d) of the definition of“zoning lot” in the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot of the Owner Parcel and the Developer Existing Zoning Lot (such zoning lot, as the samie may hereafter be enlarged in accordance with the Declaration and the terms of this Agreement, is herein referred to as the “Merged Zoning Lot"), and (ii) such other agreements,easements and licenses as are necessary to effectuate the intent of the parties in connection with the Excess Development Rights (the Declaration and such other agreements, easements and licenses are herein collectively referred to as the “Zoning Documents"); WHEREAS, the Developer Parcel and/or the Merged Zoning Lot may be the receiving site of a transfer of certain Additional Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) and Developer may acquire such Additional Development Rights for utilization on Developer Parcel or the Merged Zoning Lot (other than the Owner Parcel); WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot and other matters; NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1.
